comments.author: Glirdo
comments.body_html:
I think it’s worth installing when a majority of these are fully implemented:

  • Mannequin capable of storing a complete Equipment set

  • Junkbox for Hideout

  • Junkbox for Quests

  • Map Specific Keytools

    I’m not a mod developer so I don’t know how hard it is to implement but I would think that the mannequin would be difficult and thus it’s not a must. I would like the junkboxes or keytools the most for ease of sorting.
    This is just my thoughts and maybe a guide to what you could prioritize, I know that it’s probably hard to do so I’m patient. You don’t have to do anything that I say and you can just ignore this comment if you’d like.
